name: net.mail
doc:
net.mail: RFC 5322 addresses and messages, MIME building (text,
HTML alternatives, attachments, inline parts) and an SMTP client
(RFC 5321) with STARTTLS (RFC 3207) and implicit TLS (SMTPS, port 465)
over net.tls, and AUTH PLAIN, LOGIN and CRAM-MD5 (RFC 4954, 2195).
DKIM signing is not implemented.

items.name: CramMD5Auth
items.doc: CramMD5Auth returns credentials for the SMTP CRAM-MD5 mechanism.
items.summary: CramMD5Auth returns credentials for the SMTP CRAM-MD5 mechanism.

items.name: Dial
items.signature: async func Dial(addr string, cfg Config) *Client!
items.doc:
Connects to addr ("host:port"), reads the greeting and says EHLO;
TLS per cfg.TLS.
items.summary: Connects to addr ("host:port"), reads the greeting and says EHLO; TLS per cfg.TLS.

items.name: FoldHeader
items.signature: func FoldHeader(name string, value string) string
items.doc:
Folds a header line "Name: value" at white space so that lines stay
within 78 characters where possible (RFC 5322 2.2.3).
items.summary: Folds a header line "Name: value" at white space so that lines stay within 78 characters where possible (RFC 5322 2.2.3).

items.name: LoginAuth
items.doc: LoginAuth returns credentials for the SMTP LOGIN mechanism.
items.summary: LoginAuth returns credentials for the SMTP LOGIN mechanism.

items.name: ParseAddress
items.doc:
Parses one address: "user@host", "<user@host>", "Name <user@host>",
"\"Last, First\" <user@host>", "=?utf-8?q?...?= <user@host>", or the
old "user@host (Name)" form.
items.summary: Parses one address: "user@host", "<user@host>", "Name <user@host>", "\"Last, First\" <user@host>", "=?utf-8?q?...?= <user@host>", or the old "user@host (Name)" form.

items.name: ParseAddressList
items.doc:
Parses a comma-separated address list (group syntax "Team: a@x, b@y;"
is flattened).
items.summary: Parses a comma-separated address list (group syntax "Team: a@x, b@y;" is flattened).

items.name: PlainAuth
items.doc: PlainAuth / LoginAuth / CramMD5Auth make an Auth for one mechanism.
items.summary: PlainAuth / LoginAuth / CramMD5Auth make an Auth for one mechanism.

items.name: Send
items.signature: async func Send(addr string, auth *Auth, msg Message) void!
items.doc:
Sends msg through the server at addr with default options (see
SendWith).
items.summary: Sends msg through the server at addr with default options (see SendWith).

items.name: SendWith
items.signature: async func SendWith(addr string, cfg Config, auth *Auth, msg Message) void!
items.doc:
Connects, upgrades to TLS, authenticates (when auth is not nil) and
sends msg to all its recipients.
items.summary: Connects, upgrades to TLS, authenticates (when auth is not nil) and sends msg to all its recipients.

members.name: String
members.doc: The RFC 5322 form: the name quoted or encoded (RFC 2047) when needed.
members.summary: The RFC 5322 form: the name quoted or encoded (RFC 2047) when needed.

items.name: Attachment
items.doc:
A file attached to a message. Inline parts (with ContentID) can be
referenced from the HTML body as "cid:<ContentID>".
items.summary: A file attached to a message.

members.name: ContentType
members.doc: Default: by the file extension (mime), else application/octet-stream.
members.summary: Default: by the file extension (mime), else application/octet-stream.

items.name: Auth
items.doc:
Credentials for AUTH. Mechanism "" picks CRAM-MD5, then PLAIN, then
LOGIN among those the server offers (PLAIN/LOGIN only over TLS unless
AllowInsecureAuth).

items.name: Client
items.doc:
An SMTP client session (Dial). Methods follow the protocol order:
Hello (done by Dial), StartTLS, Authenticate, Mail, Rcpt, Data, Quit.

members.name: Cmd
members.signature: async func Cmd(line string, expect int) Reply!
members.doc: Sends a command and reads the reply; codes outside expect fail.
members.summary: Sends a command and reads the reply; codes outside expect fail.

members.name: Extension
members.doc:
Whether the server advertised an extension ("STARTTLS", "AUTH",
"SIZE", "8BITMIME", ...), and its parameters.
members.summary: Whether the server advertised an extension ("STARTTLS", "AUTH", "SIZE", "8BITMIME", ...), and its parameters.

members.name: IsTLS
members.doc: IsTLS reports whether the connection is encrypted (TLS or after STARTTLS).
members.summary: IsTLS reports whether the connection is encrypted (TLS or after STARTTLS).

members.name: StartTLS
members.doc: Upgrades the connection with STARTTLS and says EHLO again.
members.summary: Upgrades the connection with STARTTLS and says EHLO again.

members.name: Authenticate
members.doc: Authenticate logs in with a, using a mechanism the server advertises.
members.summary: Authenticate logs in with a, using a mechanism the server advertises.

members.name: Mail
members.doc: Mail sends MAIL FROM for the envelope sender.
members.summary: Mail sends MAIL FROM for the envelope sender.

members.name: Rcpt
members.doc: Rcpt sends RCPT TO for one envelope recipient.
members.summary: Rcpt sends RCPT TO for one envelope recipient.

members.name: Data
members.doc: Sends the message text (dot-stuffed).
members.summary: Sends the message text (dot-stuffed).

members.name: Reset
members.doc: Reset aborts the current mail transaction (RSET).
members.summary: Reset aborts the current mail transaction (RSET).

members.name: Quit
members.doc: Quit sends QUIT and closes the connection.
members.summary: Quit sends QUIT and closes the connection.

members.name: Close
members.doc: Close closes the connection without QUIT.
members.summary: Close closes the connection without QUIT.

members.name: TLS
members.doc:
"auto" (default: implicit TLS on port 465, else STARTTLS when
offered), "starttls" (required), "implicit", "none".
members.summary: "auto" (default: implicit TLS on port 465, else STARTTLS when offered), "starttls" (required), "implicit", "none".

members.name: TLSConfig
members.doc: TLS settings (ServerName defaults to the host).
members.summary: TLS settings (ServerName defaults to the host).

members.name: HelloName
members.doc: EHLO name (default "localhost").
members.summary: EHLO name (default "localhost").

members.name: Timeout
members.doc: Per-operation timeout in ms (0: none).
members.summary: Per-operation timeout in ms (0: none).

members.name: AllowInsecureAuth
members.doc: Allow PLAIN/LOGIN over a plain connection (tests, local relays).
members.summary: Allow PLAIN/LOGIN over a plain connection (tests, local relays).

items.name: Message
items.doc:
An email message. Build produces the RFC 5322 text: multipart/mixed
for attachments, multipart/alternative for Text + HTML,
multipart/related for inline parts; text parts are quoted-printable,
attachments base64.

members.name: Bcc
members.doc: Envelope recipients only (no header).
members.summary: Envelope recipients only (no header).

members.name: Headers
members.doc: Extra headers ("X-Mailer", "List-Unsubscribe", ...).
members.summary: Extra headers ("X-Mailer", "List-Unsubscribe", ...).

members.name: Date
members.doc: Default: now.
members.summary: Default: now.

members.name: MessageID
members.doc: Default: a random <...@sender-domain>.
members.summary: Default: a random <...@sender-domain>.

members.name: Boundary
members.doc: Fixed MIME boundaries for reproducible output (tests); default random.
members.summary: Fixed MIME boundaries for reproducible output (tests); default random.

members.name: Recipients
members.doc: All envelope recipients (To, Cc, Bcc).
members.summary: All envelope recipients (To, Cc, Bcc).

members.name: Build
members.doc: Build returns the message in RFC 5322 form (headers, MIME parts, attachments); an error without a From address.
members.summary: Build returns the message in RFC 5322 form (headers, MIME parts, attachments); an error without a From address.

items.name: Reply
items.doc: A reply: code and its lines.
items.summary: A reply: code and its lines.

members.name: Text
members.doc: Text returns the lines of the reply joined with newlines.
members.summary: Text returns the lines of the reply joined with newlines.

members.name: Message
members.doc: Message returns "smtp: CODE text".
members.summary: Message returns "smtp: CODE text".

members.name: Temporary
members.doc: 4xx: try again later.
members.summary: 4xx: try again later.
